Kai: Quick sync  new ask from field: customer wants a step-up commit ladder (3-stage) with partial escrow for onboarding and a marketplace checkout option. Can we keep marketplace discoverability but allow escrow/step-up conversion?

Monica: Short answer: yes, but with constraints. Marketplace cannot hold escrowed funds or conditional step-ups. We can implement a marketplace "entry SKU" that on purchase triggers a workflow to create a private contract holding escrow and the step-up terms. :gear:

Ezra: That sounds workable. Key decisions: 1) threshold where we force private-only (I'd say $350k ARR). 2) how we represent partner discounts (promo codes vs off-invoice credits).

Tasha: propose routing rules: a) If escrow OR KMS/HSM required -> private PO only. b) If step-up ladder >2 stages or >$350k -> private by default. c) Otherwise allow marketplace entry SKU which auto-spawns a Private Contract Draft (PCD) for escrow handling. d) If marketplace quota prevents listing -> auto-fail to private PO with 72h notice to seller.

Vin: telemetry: we should emit `signal:stepup_candidate(customer_id, sku, run_rate, pct_util)` when projected run-rate exceeds committed tier for 30 days. Also `signal:escrow_required` when onboarding checklist flags sensitive onboarding steps.

Kai: billing model: marketplace entry SKU bills the first tranche; the PCD holds escrowed remainder off-marketplace. At renewal, PCD reconciles and applies credits/step-ups per ladder. Need ops runbook to reconcile monthly draws, overages, and refunds.

Monica: Legal notes: sandbox clause needs to say marketplace purchase may initiate a private contract for escrow and step-up enforcement; customer must e-sign the PCD within 14 days or purchase is void/refundable. I'll loop Legal.

MarketplaceBot: FYI: approval required for "entry SKU" pattern and any workflow that creates private contracts from marketplace purchases. See ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-5991

Ezra: partner margin: keep checkout price visible; compute partner payout in Partner Portal as off-invoice credits. Provide sellers a post-purchase summary email with partner_split, PCD link, and expected escrow hold duration.

Tasha: migration playbook: 1) marketplace purchase triggers PCD creation; 2) ops notifies seller+partner with migration checklist; 3) escrow release occurs after onboarding sign-off; 4) if PCD not signed in 14 days -> automatic refund + deprovision. Include a 72h pre-failover notice if we move from marketplace to private due to quota.

Kai: announcement sequencing: marketing wants partner signoff + security approval 3 weeks before public listing. For partner co-announce, add 2 additional weeks.

Vin: action items: Vin -> define telemetry thresholds + example payloads (due Tue). Monica -> draft Legal clause + e-sign workflow language (due Fri). Tasha -> ops reconciliation runbook + failure modes (due Wed). Ezra -> partner payout email template + seller summary (due Thu). Kai -> open PR for routing rules and list of approval tickets (will do today).

MarketplaceBot: PR scaffold created: https://redwood.internal/prs/8320  partnerships/entry-sku-stepup (Kai).
